newsitem.title: BERMUDA: Tyco says tender offers expires.
newsitem.headline: Tyco says tender offers expires.

text.p: Tyco International Ltd said Wednesday that the tender offers to purchase for cash all of the outstanding 9-1/2 percent debentures due 2022 and 8-1/8 percent notes due 1999 of Tyco expired at noon today.
Also expired are all outstanding 8-1/4 percent senior notes due 2000 and 9-1/4 percent senior subordinated notes due 2003 of ADT Operations Inc, Tyco said.
The tender offers were made in connection with the previously announced merger of Tyco and ADT Limited, which was completed today, Tyco said.

A preliminary count shows about $150.9 million principal amount of the 9-1/2 percent debentures, about $134.5 million principal amount of the 8-1/8 percent notes, about $240.5 million principal amount of the 8-1/4 percent senior notes, and about $280.0 million principal amount of the 9-1/4 percent senior subordinated notes were tendered, Tyco said.
It is expected that all properly tendered securities will be accepted for purchase, Tyco said.
